<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>

 "brief": "## Problem\nFinance teams cannot trust the numbers reported by Keelwater's claims-handling software because the totals displayed on the Management Information (MI) dashboard do not match the totals in the exported CSV files. This discrepancy causes confusion, delays in month-end reporting, and undermines confidence in critical financial data.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Finance teams at customer accounts, who are questioning which figures are correct and experiencing delays in their reporting cycles [i:02bd63a3409aa690][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed].\n- Account management teams, who are receiving direct feedback about the issue from their clients [i:2297961a34558bd4][i:d17400eba81e6607].\n- Support teams, who are fielding a high volume of related inquiries [i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:551e3ef68cf180fa].\n- Sales teams, who are also being made aware of the problem during client interactions [i:3c15351d383b6349].\n\n## Evidence\nThe issue has been reported by 7 accounts, with a total of 14 mentions across three different routes: account_management (3 mentions), support (10 mentions), and sales (1 mention).\n\n- Thistlecombe Mutual (ARR £980,000.0) reported their finance team is pulling their hair out because the dashboard totals don't match the CSV exports [i:02bd63a3409aa690].\n- Stannary Commercial stated they are getting pushback from their finance team because the report totals differ between the dashboard and the exported file, causing a trust issue [i:2297961a34558bd4]. They also noted finance is questioning which one to trust [i:d17400eba81e6607].\n- Tidewell Marine & Cargo reported their finance team is questioning which figure is correct, causing delays in month-end close [i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed]. A sales contact also flagged that the mismatch is causing real delays for month-end reporting [i:3c15351d383b6349], and a support ticket noted the mismatch is causing confusion [i:a4003abdfc3b22b1].\n- Hollinbrook Home Insurance (ARR £2,400,000.0) reported their finance team has noticed the report totals differ when comparing dashboard numbers with exported files, causing confusion [i:3c1cd3444487dcf6][i:8376bf1faade7ec1].\n- Marrowgate Commercial reported trouble with dashboard totals not matching the CSV export [i:4c1e1128bbb746cc]. They also stated finance keeps questioning the numbers, and the mismatch is consistent with a UTC cutoff, not UK time [i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d].\n- Quillon Business Insurance (ARR £860,000.0) stated the mismatch is causing distrust in the numbers used for monthly reporting [i:551e3ef68cf180fa] and that their team is worried the numbers aren't reliable [i:711223638c96436d].\n- Duncastle Auto (ARR £80,000.0) noted that after checking roles and tasks, the numbers still don't match what was submitted previously [i:c2ebffe834fdf50b].\n\nThe total Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) from these accounts is £6,880,000.0.\n\n## Why now\nThe problem is actively disrupting critical business processes. Two of the affected accounts have renewals due within the next 90 days [i:as_of]. The issue is directly impacting finance teams during their month-end close cycles, causing reported delays [i:e6a75fe1a41e39ed][i:3c15351d383b6349]. The volume of support mentions (10) indicates this is a persistent and frequently encountered problem that requires immediate attention to maintain customer trust and contract stability [i:2e7168b298e234f6][i:4c1e1128bbb746cc][i:551e3ef68cf180fa][i:a4003abdfc3b22b1][i:3c1cd3444487dcf6][i:8376bf1faade7ec1][i:ccfc25a70dd3f36d][i:711223638c96436d][i:c2ebffe834fdf50b].",

<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.

response.content: {"critique": "I checked the headline counts (7 accounts, 14 mentions, routes 3/10/1, ARR £6,880,000) against the fact sheet and all match. The quoted phrase 'pulling their hair out' appears verbatim in the cited Thistlecombe insight, and the per-account paraphrases (Stannary trust issue, Tidewell month-end delays, Marrowgate UTC cutoff, Quillon distrust, Duncastle roles/tasks check) are each supported by their cited quotes. The 'two renewals within 90 days' claim is consistent with the fact sheet (Stannary 2026-12-05 and Marrowgate 2026-12-12, both within 90 days of the 2026-10-01 as-of date). No uncited claims, overstated scope, or ignored contrary evidence found.", "verdict": "pass"}
